paragraphs.text: Character formatting
Bold: bold words and then plain text again.
Italic: italic words and then plain text again.
Bold italic: both together and then plain text again.
Underline single: single underline and then plain text again.
Underline double: double underline and then plain text again.
Underline thick: thick underline and then plain text again.
Underline dotted: dotted underline and then plain text again.
Underline dash: dashed underline and then plain text again.
Underline wavy: wavy underline and then plain text again.
Underline words: words only underline and then plain text again.
Strikethrough: struck text and then plain text again.
Double strikethrough: double struck and then plain text again.
Superscript: raised and then plain text again.
Subscript: lowered and then plain text again.
Small caps: small capitals and then plain text again.
All caps: ALL CAPITALS and then plain text again.
Hidden:  and then plain text again.
Colour red: red text and then plain text again.
Colour green: green text and then plain text again.
Colour custom: custom colour and then plain text again.
Highlight yellow: yellow and then plain text again.
Highlight bright green: bright green and then plain text again.
Highlight turquoise: turquoise and then plain text again.
Highlight pink: pink and then plain text again.
Highlight red: red and then plain text again.
Font Calibri: Calibri text and then plain text again.
Font Times: Times New Roman text and then plain text again.
Font Arial: Arial text and then plain text again.
Font Courier: Courier New text and then plain text again.
Font Georgia: Georgia text and then plain text again.
Size 8: eight point and then plain text again.
Size 11: eleven point and then plain text again.
Size 14: fourteen point and then plain text again.
Size 24: twenty four and then plain text again.
Size 36: thirty six and then plain text again.
Spacing expanded: expanded by 3pt and then plain text again.

runs.text: Spacing expanded: expanded by 3pt and then plain text again.

paragraphs.text: Spacing condensed: condensed by 1.5pt and then plain text again.

runs.text: Spacing condensed: condensed by 1.5pt and then plain text again.

paragraphs.text: Mixed run: plain, bold, italic, bold italic, and underlined in a single paragraph.
